Dear Mrs Kessler,

Thank you for your time this morning. I put our offer in writing, as you asked.

Tollmann Toys would like to sell your Rocket Rex robots in our own shops, and we can only do that if the Hallworth's order goes well. A robot that London loves is a robot that Manchester will buy.

I asked about your whistle and your train because our own lorry would load at your bay right after the London crates. I am sorry if my questions worried you.

I pin my hotel bill to this letter, so that you can see what my firm has spent to win your trust. I take the 12:40 train home.

Yours faithfully,

::: handwriting
Oscar Brook
:::

::: small
**Pinned bill.** Hotel Carrow, Manchester. One night, 20 to 21 December 1958, Mr O. Brook, room 12.

- Room and breakfast: 25s.
- Dinner, 20 December: 7s 6d.
- Night porter: 21 December, 03:00, pot of tea to room 12, taken at the door by Mr Brook himself.
- Telephone call to Wickfold, 21 December, 08:15: 2s 4d.

Paid with thanks.
:::
